requiredDisclaimers.text: This content is personalized based on your reading interests.

promptModifiers.systemSuffix: Content must be factual and grounded in indexed articles. Do not generate opinions or editorials. Headlines must accurately reflect the content they introduce. Never fabricate quotes, statistics, or source attributions. Related content suggestions must link to real indexed articles.
contentRules: Headlines must be accurate, not sensationalized
All factual claims must come from indexed content
Reading time estimates should be accurate
Related article suggestions must reference real indexed articles

specialModes.name: digest_mode
specialModes.description: Newsletter-style digest of new content since last visit
specialModes.promptOverride: Generate a personalized content digest based on the reader's topic interests. Include 3-5 article summaries with key takeaways. Format as a scannable newsletter-style block. Only reference real indexed articles.

specialModes.name: topic_deep_dive
specialModes.description: Curated deep dive for readers showing topic affinity
specialModes.promptOverride: Generate a topic overview connecting multiple related articles. Highlight key themes, different perspectives, and suggest a reading order for comprehensive understanding. Reference only indexed content.

specialModes.name: reading_continuation
specialModes.description: Smart next-read suggestions based on reading patterns
specialModes.promptOverride: Suggest the next article to read based on the reader's interests and reading depth. Include a brief teaser that connects to what they just read. Only reference indexed articles.
